description: What shipping a basket to a place costs, by the business's own rate tables (a read, never an order): for each shipping profile its products ship under, the zone the place is in and each service with its fee in minor units (null with why: id_check, currency, weight_missing, too_heavy, over_bands). Products that do not ship, or whose price is not fixed, are listed in unquoted. An age-restricted product goes only by a service whose carrier checks ID at handover. The fee is still the business's to confirm on the order.

region.description: ISO 3166-2, when a rate depends on it: PT-20 (the Azores).
